title: Collecting Change Orders With the Ridgeline Installation Services Start-of-Work Payment
content:
Change orders billed on a Ridgeline Installation Services contract are collected, in whole or in part, together with the start-of-work payment.

**Clause.** Change order collection with the start-of-work payment: when the change orders billed on the contract were billed, the latest of them before the date work started, every change order billed is collected in full; when the latest change order was billed on or after the date work started, the program's progress payment percentage of every change order billed is collected, rounded to the cent; a contract with no change order billed has no change order collection, its change orders being left to the final payment.

The change order collection is added to the start-of-work payment.

## Terms used

- **Every change order billed** is the total of the change order billing lines on the contract.
- **The latest change order** is the most recent change order billing line on the contract, by its billing date.
- **The date work started** is the date of the most recent installation visit recorded on the contract with the outcome completed as scheduled.
- **The program's progress payment percentage** is the progress payment figure of the installation program on the contract.

| Change orders billed | Latest billed | Change order collection |
|---|---|---|
| yes | before the date work started | every change order billed, in full |
| yes | on or after the date work started | the program's progress payment percentage of every change order billed, rounded to the cent |
| none | none | none; left to the final payment |

## Worked figures (hypothetical progress payment percentage 25, work started 10 June, change orders billed 800.00 in total)

| Latest change order billed | Collection |
|---|---|
| 9 June | 800.00 |
| 10 June | 200.00 |
| 12 June | 200.00 |
| no change order | 0.00 |
